paragraphs.text: After Absalom had polluted it with most filthy fornication.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He condemns them for great ingratitude who do not praise God for his benefits.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: for thou hast lifted me up

paragraphs.text: Restored from the rebellion of Absalom.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Meaning, that he escaped death most narrowly.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: The word signifies them who have received mercy, and show mercy liberally to others.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: I put too much confidence in my quiet state as in Jer 31:18, 2Ch 32:24,25.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: I thought you had established me in Zion most surely.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: After you had withdrawn your help, I felt my misery.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: David means that the dead are not profitable to the congregation of the Lord here in the earth: therefore he would live to praise his Name, which is the end of man's creation.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Because you have preserved me that my tongue should praise you, I will not be unmindful of my duty.
paragraphs.label: l
paragraphs.anchor: glory may sing praise to thee
